hook_candidates.headline: Your AI tools don't need servers

caption:
Freelancers often waste hours setting up servers for simple AI tools. Now, Python Workers on Cloudflare are generally available—no servers, no scaling headaches. You run Python via Pyodide in WebAssembly (123MB binary). It’s ideal for client portals, automated reports, or internal tools.

Copy this prompt to generate a Cloudflare Worker template:

"Create a Cloudflare Worker template using Python with Pyodide. Include:
- A simple API endpoint
- Handling HTTP requests
- Basic error handling
- Notes on WebAssembly limitations (no multiprocessing)"

Save this workflow for when you need to deploy a custom AI tool without managing servers. 

Follow @leverageai.daily — one AI workflow a day for people who run their own business.
